brian_tavern.author: Brian Foster
brian_tavern.text: Marcus pinged me, the Tavern buttons lost their frame again on the Dec 10 Android version. My fix didn't hold, so that one is still broken.

brian_apple.author: Brian Foster
brian_apple.text: Also, Vincent told me before he left that the Apple sync line on his Android list is the same sync problem as ENG-2073, nothing new needed for it.

brian_popups.author: Brian Foster
brian_popups.text: And I never got back to the two popups from Arthur's reviews: the Axe Arena info popup still has the old frame and the Tile Dozer how-to-play popup still points at the old sprites.
